# Generator for python_vectors.json (run from legacy/python):
#   cd legacy/python && PYTHONPATH=. uv run python /home/user/code/OpenGTM/apps/backend-go/internal/playbooks/testdata/gen_vectors.py.txt > .../python_vectors.json
# Posts raw bodies through FastAPI so 422 bodies are exactly what the app emits.
import json, sys
from fastapi import FastAPI, Request
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from apps.api.routers.playbooks import PlaybookCreate, PlaybookPatch, RunCreate

app = FastAPI()

@app.post("/c")
def c(body: PlaybookCreate):
    return body.model_dump()

@app.post("/p")
def p(body: PlaybookPatch):
    return body.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)

@app.post("/r")
def r(body: RunCreate):
    return body.model_dump()

cl = TestClient(app)
P = "valid prompt text"

runc = [
 ("minimal", {"audience_id": "a"}),
 ("full", {"audience_id": "a", "max_members": 1000}),
 ("empty", {}),
 ("audience_null", {"audience_id": None}),
 ("audience_int", {"audience_id": 5}),
 ("audience_empty_ok", {"audience_id": ""}),
 ("members_0", {"audience_id": "a", "max_members": 0}),
 ("members_1001", {"audience_id": "a", "max_members": 1001}),
 ("members_str", {"audience_id": "a", "max_members": "x"}),
 ("members_null", {"audience_id": "a", "max_members": None}),
 ("members_float_frac", {"audience_id": "a", "max_members": 1.5}),
 ("two_errors", {"max_members": 0}),
 ("array_body", []),
]
def run(url, cases):
    out = []
    for name, body in cases:
        r = cl.post(url, content=json.dumps(body), headers={"content-type": "application/json"})
        out.append({"name": name, "body": body, "status": r.status_code, "response": r.json()})
    return out
raw = []
for name, content in [("invalid_json", b"{"), ("empty_body", b""), ("trailing_comma", b'{"name": "a",}')]:
    for url in ("/c", "/p"):
        r = cl.post(url, content=content, headers={"content-type": "application/json"})
        raw.append({"name": name, "path": url, "content": content.decode(), "status": r.status_code, "response": r.json()})
from apps.api.routers import playbooks as pb
from apps.api.services.playbooks.models import ResearchPlaybook, PlaybookRun, PlaybookResult
import inspect, re
def keys(cls):
    src = inspect.getsource(cls.to_api)
    return re.findall(r'"(\w+)"', src)
json.dump({"run_create": run("/r", runc), "create": run("/c", create), "patch": run("/p", patch), "raw": raw,
           "to_api_keys": {"playbook": keys(ResearchPlaybook), "run": keys(PlaybookRun), "result": keys(PlaybookResult)}},
          sys.stdout, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False)
